• Pick a dashboard from the picker (or arrive via a deep-link with the dashboard id in the URL).
  • Click Refresh to run every component report. Status updates stream in via Platform Events; tiles show a skeleton while running.
  • Use the per-tile refresh button (top-right of each tile) to re-run a single component without touching the others.
  • Click View Report on a tile footer to drill into the underlying report with the dashboard's filters pre-applied.
  • The chart-type override picker on a tile (visible when a chart renders) changes how that tile shows the same data — without modifying the saved dashboard.
